title: WHEN YOU HAVE A CASE, BRING IT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly at the entrance to the tent of meeting and said, "Our father died in the wilderness." - Num 27:1-3a (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Five sisters step forward. Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, and Tirzah come and stand before Moses, the priest, and the whole assembly. Their father had died leaving no sons, and under the customs of the day, this meant their family might lose its share in the coming inheritance. So they bring their case openly and respectfully to those in authority.

There is quiet courage here. In a culture where women rarely spoke up in such settings, these five sisters came forward together, calmly and with dignity, to seek what was right for their family. They did not stir up rebellion or complain bitterly. They simply presented their case before the Lord and His appointed leaders.

We can learn much from their example. When we face a situation that seems unfair, we need not either suffer in silent resentment or lash out in anger. There is a third way: to bring our case honestly and humbly before God and the proper authorities, trusting that what is right will be considered.

This reflects the invitation God gives us in Christ. We are welcomed to come boldly before His throne with our needs and concerns, not with grumbling but with confident, respectful faith (Heb 4:16). Whatever burden or injustice weighs on you, bring it to the Lord. He invites His children to come and be heard.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When you face unfairness, do you resent it silently or bring it forward rightly?
2. What situation do you need to bring humbly before God today?
3. How does the sisters' courage encourage you to speak up for what is right?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when I face what seems unfair, help me neither to seethe in silence nor lash out in anger. Give me the humble courage to bring my case to You, who welcomes Your children. Amen.
